I've created a new server component page that displays a dynamic timestamp on every request. I used the **Route Segment Config** `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` to opt out of static prerendering. This is the recommended approach in the App Router when you need to force dynamic rendering without relying on request-specific data like cookies or headers. ### Created File: `app/timestamp/page.tsx` ```tsx export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'; export default function TimestampPage() { const time = new Date().toISOString(); return (

Server Timestamp

Current Time: {time}

This time should update on every refresh.

); } ``` I also updated `app/page.tsx` to include a link to this new page. ### Verification I ran `npm run build` and confirmed the route is dynamic: ``` Route (app) ┌ ○ / ├ ○ /_not-found └ ƒ /timestamp ``` The `ƒ` symbol indicates the page is server-rendered on demand.
